# Working Effectively with Legacy Code for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/legacy-code/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/legacy-code
```

Gemini asks you to confirm before it installs (trust and consent prompts).

- 35 skills (including 6 mode skills). Gemini's documentation says each is also a slash command `/legacy-code:legacy-code-<name>`; that was not exercised in a live session here.
- 20 subagents, started with `@legacy-code-<name> <task>`.
